svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — landing page (concept 08 Guide Map)

g.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads the Locations, Inventory
and Transactions files your warehouse already exports,
classifies every part by its picks and recommends moves
in rounds. Every move names its rule and its numbers.
Synthetic demo data, ready to explore. Runs on a laptop,
no accounts, no network calls, no AI at runtime.
Never claims distance, shelf capacity, metres saved or live stock.
The data-as-of date is always on screen.
errors name the file, row and column
apply · another location · keep in place
The tool suggests; the planner decides.
fast-moving part into a best location
slow-moving part or dead stock out of a best location
